P01.rationale: There is no founder or person used as a dominant human anchor; the page relies entirely on typography and abstract layout.

P05.rationale: The page contains no case studies with client portraits; it consists of text blocks and typographic elements only.

P07.rationale: There is no social-proof apparatus such as a press wall, rating cards, or review grid present on the page.

P10.rationale: Oversized decorative typographic elements are present in the form of large ghost numerals ('11') and oversized quote glyphs at the bottom.

P11.rationale: There are no real data-visualisations bound to numbers; the page contains only text blocks without charts or cost-math.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with tight typography and structured columns.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present through the use of a solid dark blue color field that creates a cohesive mood.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page to require treatment for text readability.

P16.rationale: There are no device or product mockups shown; the layout consists purely of typographic and editorial elements.

N07.rationale: The imagery is not generic stock but rather specific to a real business context through its tailored typography and content structure.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is dense with text blocks filling most of the page area.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on a busy photo without scrim because there are no photos overlaid with text in this design.
